topics.topic: Whether channel-bound killing is immediate or deferred until the --info-fd report
questions: Must the environment be killed when the channel bound is passed, or may that action be deferred until the --info-fd report arrives?
Must the environment be killed when the channel exceeds its bound, or must that action be delayed until the --info-fd report arrives?

quotes: It opens the pidfd of that child-pid at once, and a wall deadline or channel bound passed before the report arrived is acted on when it arrives.
judgement.why: The text requires a channel-bound exceedance detected before the child-pid report to be acted on when that report arrives.

topics.topic: Whether wall-deadline killing is immediate or deferred until the --info-fd report

quotes: It opens the pidfd of that child-pid at once, and a wall deadline or channel bound passed before the report arrived is acted on when it arrives.
